action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that zcat in zutils incorrectly handled the -v option,
leading to a buffer overflow. If a user were tricked into opening a
specially crafted compressed file, an attacker could possibly use this
issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.
isummary:
zutils could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a
specially crafted file.
